product_metadata.title: Dreo Air Purifier Macro Pro, Air Purifiers for Home Large Rooms, H13 True HEPA Filter, 679 ft² Coverage, Low-Noise, Auto Mode, 360 Filtration, Remove 99.97% Dust Smoke Pollen for Pets Allergies
features: Designed for Larger Rooms: Dreo Air Purifiers coupled with a pioneering brushless DC motor, patented airflow system circulates a large amount of fresh air. Purifies for Large room 679 sq ft (63.6 m²) in 30 minutes, refreshes the air 5x per hour in rooms as large as 283 ft² / 25 m², eliminating a variety of airborne impurities at ultra-fast speeds with TurboPure Technology and 360° air intake..amperage : 1 amp

H13 True HEPA Filtration: H13 true HEPA filter has proven to capture 99.97% of particles down to 0.3μm — allergens, dust, pet dander, pollen, smoke, odor, VOCs. 3-in-1 deep filtration with H13 True HEPA purifiers tackles various harmful pollutants from all sides. The most effective filter to build a cleaner environment for your better health. You can buy new filters by searching "B09X3G8P1G". No need to worried about expensive filter for longer use.

Certifications Worldwide: AHAM certified and SGS tested for the ability to clean tobacco smoke, dust, pollen. Also complies with European Centre for Allergy Research Foundation standards (ECARF) and is trusted by California Air Resources Board (CARB).Also, FCC certified, ETL listed

Quieter Than Breathing: Integrated airflow system smooths out air turbulence for a more soothing flow. Along with a brushless DC motor to deliver fresh air as quiet as 20 dB in sleep mode, creating a peaceful environment for your sleep and work.

User Friendly：The filter life is measured by an advanced algorithm, will provide longer life and fresh air to you.A timer for 2/4/8 hours and filter life time indicator for your convenience. 6 modes(3 fans mode, sleep mode, turbo mode and auto mode) fits your all requests in air purification.

Save More, Live Better: Costs only 12 cents to run at auto mode for a whole week, certified by ENERGY STAR to save more on your electric bills. Dreo Macro Pro senses indoor air quality and will switch to its ideal fan speed in real time. You can enjoy everything you love, Dreo will take care of the rest.
